text:
alex: Customer reported tool call 'charge_customer' returns 400 schema validation when amount is passed as string. They see: 'invalid_type: expected number but got string'. Repro on their prod calls intermittently, started after yesterday's rollout. Including curl and sample payload.

support-bot: Created case #SUP-7129 for customer AcmeCorp.

maya: Can you paste the exact request body + model id + route? Also which env (hosted/dedicated/private)?

alex: Payload:
```
POST /v1/invoke
{
  "tool": "charge_customer",
  "args": { "customer_id": "cust_123", "amount": "49.99", "currency": "USD" }
}
```
Route: /v1/invoke/toolcall; model: open-instruct-3b; customer on Hosted. Logs show schema validation failing in runtime before tool dispatch.

eli: Is this the same regression that caused failing golden prompt in CI yesterday? CI flakes started after the runtime change that relaxed type coercion.

jordyn: I ran the golden-toolcall suite locally — one test expects amount to be number, but our wrapper coerces numbers to strings for legacy customers. That mismatch would fail evals. See failing test:
```
--- FAIL: TestGoldenCharge
expected: {"amount": 49.99}
actual:   {"amount": "49.99"}
```

maya: Oof. So two issues: (1) runtime will reject string (schema validation) for strict models, (2) our golden prompts in CI assume coercion. Need reproduction steps and quick mitigations.

alex: Repro steps I've used:
1) curl with payload above against hosted /v1/invoke/toolcall
2) Observe 400 with body: {"error":{"message":"invalid_type: expected number but got string","type":"schema_error"}}
3) Run gw logs: `kubectl logs -l app=redwood-runtime -n prod --since=1h | grep charge_customer`

maya: Short term mitigation: add a route-level compatibility shim to coerce numeric strings to numbers when tool schema allows. Can eng-runtime pick this up for hotspot customers?

@eng-runtime: please triage; this is causing customer outage and CI regression for toolcall golden tests. Priority P1.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-5532 (P1) — Assigned to eng-runtime oncall.

eli: For CI regression: I'll update the golden test suite to include a negative test that fails if coercion is happening silently. But we should not ship a shim without a feature flag.

jordyn: I can produce a patch that adds a feature-flagged shim and a data migration plan for dedicated/private. Also add unit tests: schema_validator_test -> test_coercion_disabled.

maya: Can someone post the minimal runtime stack trace when validation fails? We need the exact module and line.

alex: From logs:
```
runtime/schema_validator.go:112: ValidateArgs() -> error: invalid_type expected number but got string
runtime/tool_router.go:78: Dispatch aborted for charge_customer
```

sam: Assigning to @eli and @jordyn. Also notifying support to tell customer we have a mitigation plan.

support-bot: Noted. Customer update queued: "We are rolling a compatibility shim behind a flag; ETA 2 hours."

maya: Next steps: (1) eng-runtime: review shim PR + run golden tests (2) eng-ml: check model-side schema expectations and consider tolerant parser (3) support: send customer update in 30m. I'll coordinate rollback if needed.

alex: Adding repro artifacts to case SUP-7129: screenshots, curl logs, and CI failure links: https://ci.internal/runs/4589

eli: I'll open PR for feature-flagged shim and ping here when ready for review. :thumbsup: 

jordyn: Will add test coverage and a small migration doc.

maya: Thanks team — keep updates here. If the shim passes golden tests, we can flip flag for this customer only and avoid full rollout.

alex: Closing note: customer accepted temporary workaround. Will reopen if we see further failures.
